tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs dang 'brel bar sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'i lag len dri med kun snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs dang 'brel bar sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'i lag len dri med kun snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs dang 'brel bar sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'i lag len dri med kun snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo bud+dhā ya/ gang gsung bdud rtsi'i zegs ma phra rab kyang*// 'jig rten bcud mchog kun gyis mi bsgrun pa// thub gsung snying gi ze'u 'brur chags pa yis// blo dman dad pa can gyi dbyig 'di sbyin// gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs las mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dang lnga gdab pa'i cho ga gnyis dngos su gsungs shing*/ 'bum phrag btab pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i shugs las stong rtsa sogs gdab pa'i cho ga'ang bstan par grub cing*/ de'i don gsal shes grub tu brgya'am stong sogs dkyil 'khor gcig tu btab pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad la/ gang ltar sā ts+tsha brgya brgyad la gzungs ring thung dang skor ba brgya rtsa 'gro ba'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes tshang tshar re 'gro dgos pa gzhung gi dgongs pa dang bla ma rnams kyi phyag len yin pas/ 'byor pa che na cho ga tshar re la sā ts+tsha brgya brgyad dang mchod pa de mtshungs bshams pa'i tshar stong phrag gcig gis mchod rten 'bum 'grub pa byas na phan yon tshad med cing*/ de ltar gyi tshe cho ga mkhan po dge slong bzhi sde tsam dang gzungs dang skor ba'i grangs spyi 'go nas 'gro bar byas na 'tshams par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'byor ba chung bas de ltar mi lcogs na sā ts+tsha stong phrag re dang brgya mchod sogs bshams te dge slong bcu tham pas cho ga btang na tshar grangs brgya phrag gis 'bum ther 'grub par 'gyur la/ de ltar gyi tshe cho ga re la gzungs dang skor ba mi res brgya rtsa re 'grub dka' bas lan bcu gcig re byas na spyi nas brgya dang bcu 'gro bas des kyang rung zhing*/ bar rnams ni de yis rigs 'gres pas chog go /shin tu 'byor pa dman pas cho ga tshar grangs mang po mi 'grub la sā ts+tsha grangs mang gdab par 'dod na/ gzhi yangs por pad+ma'i gdan mang por sā ts+tsha gang shong bsgrig /mchod pa yang ci 'byor bshams nas dge slong grangs ka gang 'dzom gyis cho ga btang*/

de ltar nyin gcig gam gsum sogs la cho ga gang thon gyis sā ts+tsha rdzogs par byas na cho ga ma byas pa las ni phan yon 'gyur khyad shin tu che zhing*/ 'byor pas ma lcogs pa la nyes pa'ang med do// tshar grangs mang nyung gang byed kyang bsham bkod sogs ni 'og tu gsal ba'i rgyas bsdus gang 'grub ma 'khrul ba bya dgos so// de ltar spyir rgyas bsdus byed tshul gyi rnam dbye phyes par byas nas/ bye brag lag len dngos bshad pa la bzhi/ sā ts+tsha 'debs pa'i rim pa/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i bsham bkod/ cho ga rgyas bsdus btang tshul/ rjes ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sā ts+tsha'i rgyu 'jim pa'i sa gang nas len pa'i gnas der/ dkar gtor dang gser skyems bsham/ rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal gyis byin brlabs la 'bul tshig rgyas bsdus ci 'grub bya/ tshon skud lnga bsgril gyi skud pas sa ji tsam len dgos pa'i rgya khyon gyi mthar gru bzhir bcad la/ oṃ badz+ra sū tra hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ sa la gnas pa'i gdon bgegs bsam sbyor ngan pa mchod rten dang dge ba'i las la bar du gcod pa rnams rdo rje'i rwa bas mtshams bcad/ gzhi de nyid mchod rten gyi rgyu rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad pa lnga dbus dang thig gi grwa bzhir gdab/ gcig las ma 'byor na 'debs pa'i tshul byas la mthar dbus su gdab ste/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba du ṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun brjod la/ sa ji tsam dgos pa blangs ma zin gyi bar thig dang phur bu mi bsdu'o// de nas til dang yungs kar la/ oṃ a mṛ te ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas la 'thor bas/ bgegs thams cad tshar bcad de sa'i phyogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs gnas dpag tu med par gyur/ ces dang*/ gzungs thung yang brjod la byin gyis brlab bo// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kha na hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces bzla zhing sa brko/ sa gzhi rin chen rnam lnga brkos pa yis// de bzhin gshegs sku rnam dag rgyur gyur cig / ces brjod la yid kyis kyang dmigs pa gzhan la'ang 'gre'o// sa gtsang ma blangs pa gnas gtsang mar spungs la rdo rje gsum pa'i phyag rgya bcas tho bas brdung la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun sogs brjod/ nyon mongs bag chags byang zhing 'joms gyur cig / 'jim pa brdzi ba ni/ chu gtsang dri zhim spos dang sbyar ba la rdo rje'i phyag rgya gtugs te/ spos chu'i steng du a las zla dkyil las/ 'od 'phros chu nyid bdud rtsi rang bzhin gyur/ oṃ a mri te hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis byin brlabs pas 'jim pa brdzis la/ oṃ badz+ra pra marda nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rten snying bzlas/ 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur gyur cig / de nas 'jim pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ shu d+dhe na du sho dha ya swā hā/ pad zlar 'jim pa rin chen phung por gyur// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'og min du// 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad thugs rgyud bskul// de las 'od 'phros 'gro rgyud nyon mongs sbyangs// slar 'dus 'jim pa'i phung po la thim pas// bde gshegs kun gyi ye shes rang bzhin gyur// lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan pa gyen bstan dang*/ lag g.yas de bzhin byas pa kha sbubs pa'i bar du 'jim pa bzhag la/ na mo bha ga ba te bai ro tsa na pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sa mya k+saṃ bu d+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su k+ṣ+me su k+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shā n+te dān+te/ a sa ma ro pe/ a na la m+be/ ta ra m+be/ ya sho ba ti/ ma hā te dza/ ni ra ku le/ ni ra ku le/ nirbā ṇe/ sarba bu d+dhā a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes rnam snang gi gzugs ring lan nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka swā hā/ nyer gcig /gzungs thung ci nus bzlas/ 'jim pa bcad la/ na maḥs man+ta bu d+dhā nāṃ/

oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ 'chi med rdo rje'i srog zungs thob par shog / 'bi 'bi byas la/ oṃ badz+ro d+dha bā ya swā hā/ 'od zer 'jig rten kun khyab 'gro don byas// slar 'dus 'bi 'bi shel gong ltar dag pa// ye shes rdo rje 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyur// brkos phor du snum byugs la/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ thabs shes zung 'jug ye shes rdul bral gyur// brkos phor du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ chos dbyings rtag pa'i snying po rnyed par gyur// legs par gdab la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phyag rgyas btab par gyur// gzungs bsgril mgo mjug ma log par gzhug la/ oṃ badz+ra gar+bhe swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ zhes dang gzungs thung yang bzla/ dbyings ye gnyis med chos sku'i mchod rten ni// 'byams klas ye shes snying po khong chud gyur// phyir phyung la/ oṃ dharma ra te swā hā/ chos kyi sku las gzugs sku grangs med byon// 'gro don 'khor ba ji srid mdzad par gyur// skam thag chod nas chos 'khor sogs rgyan btags par mos la/ oṃ pra ma na ye swā hā/ rin chen rgyan bkod sna tshogs gsol ba yis// yon tan kun rdzogs 'gro don mdzad gyur cig / sku dkar sogs na bza' gsol la/ oṃ dharma dhātu swa bhā ba bi shu d+dhe dharma te swā hā/ chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i don ldan shog / ces pa'i cho ga rnams kyis btab zin nas gdan la bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ oṃ su pra ti ṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swā hā/ zhes bzla bzhin du bsgrig /rgyal ba thams cad rten 'di dang*// dbyer med brtan par bzhugs su gsol// ces brjod/ de ltar sā ts+tsha 'debs pa'i tshe 'byor ba dang bstun pa'i klog mkhan grangs ci rigs khrus sogs gtsang sbra dang ldan pas skyabs sems/

sa gzhi byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol lha khrus yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskul ba dang*/ ris med pa'i sems can rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa btang bar sems bskyed de/ brgyad stong pa sogs sher phyin gyi mdo/ gser 'od dam pa/ 'dus pa'i rin po che'i tog /'phags pa gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa dang*/ gtsug gtor dri med kyi mdo gzungs rnams rgyun mi 'chad par gsal dag tu bklags la/ mthar rten snying dang*/ chos bshad pa las byung ba sogs kyis bsngo ba'ang bya/ de thams cad ma 'grub na'ang sher snying dang dri med kyi gzungs ring thung*/ khyad par snying po'i gzungs thung rtag tu bzla/ shin tu 'dzom na sā ts+tsha 'debs pa dang sgrub pa'i tshe dza ba rgyun kyang btsugs par gsungs te gal yang che'o// de dag rnams kyis sā ts+tsha gdab pa'i bya ba 'grub bo// de la nang gzhug dri med kyi gzungs ring thung gnyis ka dgos kyang brgya brgyad tsam la de bzhin 'grub pa ci nas gal che zhing*/ khri 'bum la de bzhin 'grub dka' bas gzungs thung kho nas chog /gang ltar rgya shog sogs la spar du btab nas dri bzang gis byugs pa'am mtshal snag la bsres kyang rung*/ shug pa sogs bzang shing mgo mjug ma log pa'i srog shing mtshon byed la gzungs kyi dbu nas sngags ngo nang bstan tu dril ba bcug /sā ts+tsha skam thag chod nas zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po sogs las bzhi'i mdog mtshungs kyi kha dog bsgyur ba gsungs kyang dkyus su thams cad sku dkar legs par gsol zhing*/ gdugs kyi mtshon byed dar tshon sna lnga gang 'dzom gyi dum bu re'ang sā ts+tsha'i dbu la sbyar grub na legs so// sā ts+tsha'ang phal cher gyis mchod brgya ma khri phrag la 'bum ther byed srol snang yang*/ 'di'i gzhung nas gsungs pa'i 'bum phrag ni gzungs nyid la dgongs pa yin pas nges par gzungs 'bum phrag dang ldan pa'i sā ts+tsha 'bum phrag grub dgos pas mchod brgyad ma grangs ldan btab na lag len bde zhing khungs btsun par snang ngo*// gnyis pa bsham bkod pa ni/

mkhan po'i gzhung du rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par ma gsungs kyang*/ dri med 'grel pa slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa nyid phal cher gyis tshad mar byed pas de'i lugs dang sbrel na gnyis/ rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhi der slob dpon gyis dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul zhing*/ thig gis bcad pa dang*/ phur gdab/ til yungs brabs shing gzungs thung brjod pa yan chad gong du sā ts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho gar bshad pa rnams sngar nyin du grub par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs pu sa rdo las brtsigs pa'am shing la bzos kyang rung ste dbyibs gru bzhi/ steng me long ltar 'jam zhing mnyam pa/ ngos bzhir seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri rkang 'bur ram ri mor bris pa/ rgya tshad cho ga tshar re la sā ts+tsha grangs gang bzhugs nyid shong bar byed dgos pas sā ts+tsha che chung sogs dang bstun pa'i steng du ba byung lnga dang gur gum tsan+dan sogs dri'i chus chag chag gdab/ de nas phyag len gyi gtso bo mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad pa ltar na/ gzhal yas khang rta babs med pa'i sgo rkyang gi phyi rol khrus rdzing pad+ma 'od zer gyi khor yug dang bcas pa'i thig tshon spyi ltar la/ tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon bzhi por cha drug rer bgos pa'i re'u mig sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re bri/ de'i cha lnga pa yan chad rnams su sā ts+tsha brgya rtsa bzhugs pa'i gnas yin cing*/ cha drug pa'i tshangs thig phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi re'u mig gnyis gnyis la sā ts+tsha re re bzhugs pas brgyad tshang*/ de'i 'phros 'phags pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i lha snam yin la/ shong yangs che na thog ma nas cha bdun rer phyes te lha snam rim gnyis su byas na'ang legs so// gal te cho ga gcig la sā ts+tsha stong rtsa bzhugs na phyogs rer cha drug cu rer dbye dgos pas mtshon/ bar rnams rigs pas dpag

/de ltar dkyil 'khor yang sā ts+tsha blang bzhag gi tshe mi zub pa bya dgos pas shing stegs yin na chu tshon gyi sa bris nas rtsi btang ba sogs shes par bya/ de nas re'u mig gi pad+ma re la sā ts+tsha re bzhag ste/ de'ang thog mar dbus/ de nas shar lho nub byang rim bzhin g.yas bskor du dgod/ dbus su 'phrul stegs la lug ma la sogs pa'i mchod rten sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang ldan pa bzhugs/ steng du gdugs dang bla bre/ logs su 'phan dang rgyal mtshan/ khyad par ba dan dmar po brgya rtsa brgyad logs rer nyer bdun re bkod legs mdzes par bkram/ de dag gi dbus kyi char 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi nang du thig le sngon po la gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs ring thung gser gyis bris pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir mchod rten dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi'i bum sgor gzungs thung*/ gdugs la gzungs ring bris pa'i thang ka'ang bsham/ sku gdung rnams kyi phyi rol ngos bzhir bum pa rgyan ldan bzhi'i nang 'bru lnga sman lnga rin po che lnga dang dri chab blugs pa'i khar/ snod gtsang mar bye ma brngos nas dug phyung ba yungs kar dang bsres pa bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir spos phor bzhi bzhag ste tsan+dan dang a ga ru dang tu ru ṣ+ka dang gu gul bzhi po rgyun ma chad par bdug /tu ruṣ+ka dngos ma rnyed na spos dkar gyis rung*/ sgo bzhir mchod yon gyi snod bzhi bzhag pa'i nang du/ gur gum 'bras yos nas til dkar ku sha 'o ma me tog dkar po ste rdzas bdun cung zad re blugs/ mchod yon sbreng ba'i bya ma bum chu gtsang gis bkang ba dang*/ khrus snod me long sku phyi na bza'/ rgyal chen phyogs skyong sde brgyad rnams la zlum gtor gsum rnams kyang stegs bde bar bzhag /me tog mar me zhal zas gtso bor gyur pa'i nyer spyod lnga brgya phrag gi phreng bas mtshon mchod pa'i bye brag rgyas par bsham dgos kyang dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sā ts+tsha len bzhag skabs stabs mi bde bas/

bar phyes nas phyogs phyogs kyi stegs bur bsgrigs pa rnams kyi dbus su snod gtsang mar tsā ru'i bza' ba zlum gtor che legs dkar mngar shing tog gi bza' bca' sna tshogs dang ldan pa sman lnga 'bru lnga dri lnga snying po lnga ste phrag lnga'i rdzas/ bkra shis rdzas rtags 'bur ram ri mor bris pa rnams rten la kha phyogs te bkod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du khrus bum mam dung phor dri chab kyis bkang ba/ yungs kar dang 'thor nas/ gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag mdo chog la 'os pa'i rigs kyang 'du bya'o// gnyis pa bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa chog rnams 'dor len ji ltar byas kyang rung la/ dkyil 'khor sgo dang rta babs sogs med pa'i pad+ma'i gdan snam bu dang bcas pa bri/ bsham bkod rigs gong ltar la gzungs dang mchod rten bris pa'i thang ka lnga po mi dgos la/ brgya mchod rnams gang 'byor byas nas tshar re bzhin kha gso/ tsā ru'i bza' ba'ang dkyil 'khor mdun du tshar gcig bkod pas chog /bum pa bzhi mi 'dzom na gcig bye snod bcas slob dpon mdun du bzhag /spos phor yang gcig gis mtshon tsam rung zhing bzang spos ma 'dzom na shug pa dang a ga ru dkyus ma sil sogs bdug pas go chod/ lnga tshan lnga ma 'byor na ri mor bris pas kyang rung ngo*// gsum pa cho ga btang tshul la gnyis/ thung mong gi lag len/ bye brag dbye bsdu'o// dang po ni/ bslab pa dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis mgo lus la khrus bya zhing bkru/ chos gos rnam gsum tshul dang ldan par bgo /khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi khrims bzung la khrus dang gos gtsang ma gyon/ sha chang sgog gtsong ma yin pa'i dkar mngar gyi bza' btung bag yod par longs spyad/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ gnyid dang le lo/ gzhan la gnod 'tshe sogs ma dag pa'i bsam sbyor ci nus su spang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang mdo sde dang mchod rten gyi phan yon la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang gus pa cher bskyed/

sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rje'i sems bskyed la cho ga'i tshig dal brel ran cing sngags sgra dag pa sogs gal che/ 'grub tu rung na don zhags lugs kyi theg chen gso sbyong blangs la tshul khrims rnam dag gzungs bzla ba nangs re bzhin byas na shin tu legs 'byor pas lcogs na gong smos mdo sde rnams klog pa po gcig /gzungs bzla ba po gcig bcas bzhag go /gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyas pa/ 'bring po/ bsdus pa'o// dang po ni/ dge 'dun rnams gral du 'khod pa dang rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs brjod/ snying po dang khrus bdun rig pa ci 'grub bzlas pas bum pa'i chu byin brlabs te 'dus pa rnams nas khrus dang 'thor 'thung byas mthar phan yon brjod/ spro na thub bstod gang rung 'don/ 'greng ste sems brtse ma brjod la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mngon sum lta bur dmigs nas phyag bya/ de nas gdan la 'khod de/ shes pas grub pa las/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha stu be swā hā/ lan gsum brjod pa nas brtsams/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang thams cad bskur bar gyur ba dang*/ de'i gong du yod pa/ oṃ traiya sogs sngags tshan bzhi/ oṃ rat+na tsaid+ya sogs gong 'og gi sngags thams cad lan gsum gsum dang*/ bar gyi dmigs pa rnams kyang*/ gyur cig ces smon lam du bsgyur ba sogs shes par byas la rten dang yo byad spyir byin gyis brlab/ yang na 'di dag kho bos gsar bsgrig dri med lam 'jug ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas gang gis rten cing 'brel ba 'byung*// sogs dang*/ gang zhing rkyen las skyes pa sogs sh+loka brjod la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ de nas dri med chog gzhung ltar/ chos thams cad don dam par sogs nas/ dgod par bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bdag ni dus ngan pa'i sogs kyi sems bskyed la/ sa gzhi rten mchod byin rlabs dang*/ bden stobs brjod pa lan gsum gsum/ de nas mar me sbar/ bdug spos btul/ dge 'dun rnams pus btsugs thal sbyar te me tog blangs la/ bcom ldan dpal shākya thub pa sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab par ci gnang zhes pa'i tshig gong ma'i bar/ de nas mchod 'bum las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang sogs nas/ gshegs shing gzhes par gsol/ ces pa'i bar dang*/ slar chos gzhung las/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nas/ ci gnang zhes pa'i bar/ mchod 'bum las/ lha'i 'jig rten nas/ de lta bur gshegs par gsol/ ces pa'i bar gyis rgyal ba sras bcas/ mchod rten chos skyong ba bcas spyon drangs la bar mtshams rnams su me tog 'thor zhing rol mo'i sgra bya/ chog gzhung las/ pho brang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ bzhugs par gyur ba na/ 'grengs la phyag lan bdun 'tshal bzhin du/ mchod 'bum ltar/ ye shes tshogs kyis sogs byon phyag 'bul ba nas/ smon lam 'jug / myur thob shog bar btang*/ ar+ghaṃ

'bul ba'i skabs phyogs bzhir mchod yon sbreng*/ khrus kyi skabs phyogs bzhi'i bum pas phyogs so so nas khrus gsol ba sogs dang*/ mchod pa rnam lnga 'bul ba'i thog mar mchod sprin gyi sngags lan gsum brjod/ yungs kar 'bul ba'i skabs su yungs kar 'thor ba dang rol mo sogs bya/ mchod 'bum la gong 'og 'khrugs cung zad snang yang lag len mi bde bas btang snyoms su bzhag pa'o// de nas 'greng la phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ chog gzhung ltar na/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sogs nas/ chos dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal ba yan dang*/ mchod 'bum las/ shes rab mchog gis sogs nas/ rmad rdzogs mnga' la phyag 'tshal bstod par/ chog gzhung las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi nas phyag 'tshal rdzogs pa'i/ skyabs su mchi'o bar brjod la phyag bya/ gdan la 'khod nas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad sogs nas/ mchod cing 'bul lo bar dang mchod sprin gyi gzungs bcas rol mo bya/ de nas mchod 'bum las/ ye shes tshogs rdzogs sogs mthar chags su btang ba las/ ar+ghaṃ gsol ba'i skabs bya ma bum spos kyis 'dug /lag thal sbyar gyis dpral bar bzung la phyogs bzhi'i mchod yon gyi snod rnams su g.yas bskor du sbreng*/ rgyal chen sogs la mchod cing bstod pa ma gtogs gtor 'bul gzhung 'dir ma bshad pas mi dgos kyang spyi ltar spro na 'gal ba med pas/ mchod rten bstod pa grub nas 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swā bhā bas sbyang*/ cha gsum ltar thun mong du byin brlab/ rgyal chen bzhi'i sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ shar phyogs na ni sogs kyis bstod cing phrin las bcol/ oṃ in+d+rā ya sogs kyis phyogs skyong dang*/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga sogs kyis sde brgyad la 'bul zhing mchod bstod byas la gtor ma gshegs/ sdig pa bshags pa nas/ byang chub bsngo ba'i bar gzhung rdzogs par grub pa dang*/

chog gzhung snga ma'i 'phros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol sogs nas/ de bzhin du gyur cig bar gzhung las lan gsum gsungs pa rnams kyang de ltar brjod/ de nas gtsug tor dri med kyi mdo gzungs dbu'i rgya skad nas bzung tshar gcig bklag /gzungs ring thung la slebs pa dang de dag brgya rtsar bzla dgos pas gcig gis grangs 'gro dka' na spyi mgor brtsis kyang rung ngo*// gzungs mdo grub pa dang*/ chog gzhung ltar/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/ dbyings la 'god par gyur cig bar brjod/ gzungs ring thung brjod cing gzungs bum rnams kyi bum chu bkyes la 'thor 'thung bya/ de nas rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi sngags dang 'od zer dri med las 'byung ba'i skor ba'i sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/ gzungs ring thung gnyis ka'am mi shes na gzungs thung bzla bzhin du skor ba lan brgya rtsa brgyad/ de'ang mi lcogs na mi grangs la brtsi'o// de nas gdan la 'khod de mchod rten bskor ba'i phan yon dang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs bcad gnyis ka'am mi nus na res mos su bklag /de na skabs 'dir bzang spyod smon lam 'don par gsungs kyang cho ga tshar grangs mang po'i skabs sā ts+tsha rnams blang bzhag gi khyad kyis rjes nas 'don na legs/ de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad la sogs nas/ mchod cing 'bul lo bar dang*/ mchod sprin sngags bcas brjod/ gzhung ltar bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol bya/ rten la dmigs nas brtan bzhugs byas kyang rung*/ de nas gong du ma 'don na bzang spyod 'dir 'don cing*/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs shis brjod bya/ tshar grangs mang po'i skabs de'i tshe las rdor sogs kyis sā ts+tsha rnams gzhan du spyan drangs la/ rjes ma rnams dkyil 'khor du bsgrig pa dang*/ mchod gtor gsar du bsham pa dang kha gso ba sogs bya'o// gnyis pa cho ga 'bring po tsam byed na/

spyi'i lag len sogs rgyas pa ltar la/ thog mar tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa lta bu'i tshigs brjod nas 'phags pa rnams la phyag bya/ gang gis rten cing sogs stong pa nyid bsgom pa nas brtsams chog gzhung ltar btang ba las/ spyan 'dren snga phyi'i bar du mchod 'bum ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang sogs kyis mchod rten spyan 'dren sbyar/ chog gzhung gi phyag mchod dang*/ gleng gzhi brjod cing thugs dam bskul ba/ bden pa dar zhing yid kyis bsngo ba rnams grub pa'i rjes su/ gzungs mdo/ sngags bzlas/ yan lag bdun pa/ bskor ba/ phan yon gyi tshigs bcad/ mchod pa/ bzod gsol sogs kyang rgyas pa dang 'dra la/ mdor na mchod 'bum las mchod rten spyan 'dren sbyor ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan chog gzhung kho na tshang bar btang ba yin no// gsum pa cho ga bsdus pa ni/ chog gzhung las snying por phyung na'ang phyogs tsam rung mod/ 'phri bsnan 'ga' zhig ma byas na/ 'bring bsdus 'di dag la cho ga'i cha lag tshang dka' ba dang*/ 'phri bsnan bsal 'od mang na lag len tu khyer mi bde bas bsdus pa'i cho ga dri med lam 'jug ces bya ba nag 'gros zur du bkod pa las rtogs par bya'o// de'ang cho ga tshar grangs mang du bya dgos pa'i tshe snga dro thog mar rgyas pa tshar gcig btang*/ de nas 'bring po tshar gcig /de nas bsdus pa du thon bya ba'am/ rgyas pa'i khongs su 'bring po'ang 'du bas zur du mi bya bar rgyas pa tshar gcig gi rjes su bsdus pa nyid gang 'grub byas na bde zhing legs par mngon no// bzhi pa rjes ni/ sā ts+tsha brgya stong lta bu nyung ngu las mi 'grub na de dag gi cho ga zin nas tsha khang lta bu phyag bskor sogs bkur bsti dang tshogs bsags kyi rten tu 'gyur la chud mi za ba'i gnas su dbu zhabs ma logs par bzhugs su gsol bas 'thus shing*/ 'bum ther lta bu la lam gyi gzhi mdo'am gong smos kyi gnas sogs su/ sa chog sngon du 'gro bas khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs pa'i nang dbus su rdo la brkos pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs 'du byas te/

dri med rnam gnyis kyi cho ga'i gzhung ji lta bar srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga byas la/ gtsug tor dri med kyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'od zer dri med kyi mchod rten dgu bcu rtsa dgu rnams dbus su bang sgrom lta bur bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du sā ts+tsha byings rnams kyang dbu zhabs ma logs par bzhugs su gsol na phan yon bsam las 'das pa gzhung de dag tu gsal ba ltar ro// gal te 'od zer dri med kyi sā ts+tsha'i cho ga byed na'ang gzhung 'di dag la smon lam sogs cung zad kha bsgyur bas 'grub ste de'i tshul ni lo chen dharma shrī'i yig cha sogs su shes par bya'o// cho ga lan cig grub kyang ngan 'gro yi// skye sgo gcod cing byang chub tshogs rdzogs pa'i// thabs mchog sangs rgyas zhal nas ched bsngags pa// dang du len pa'i skal can deng sang dkon// 'on kyang snying nas yid ches dad pa yis// bris 'dis ring bsrel snying po can gyi gdung*// rnam dag cho ga'i gzi ldan sa gsum khyab// bzang po spyod pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs shog /dri med cho ga'i lag len 'di nyid skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bcu bzhi pas bka' stsal me tog spyi bor bcings shing*/ snga phyir don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gi bzhed pa skong ba'i phyir dang*/ chos tshul khyad par 'phags pa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas par gyur na ci ma rung snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i ming can blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel// zhes pa 'di'ang nā tha sid+dhi'i spar du bsgrubs pa'o// na mo gu ru sa ma ya badz+rā ya/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas mdor bsdus ni/ skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang nyid tha mal spyi bo ru// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus// sems can sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus te// yongs gyur bla ma bcom ldan 'das// dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog ljang*// zhi 'dzum ral ba'i thor tshugs can// phyag g.yas ral gri thugs kar bsnams// g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten// yu ba sna tshogs rdo rjes sras// dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka ru// nyi steng khaṃ mthar sngags phreng bskos// mos gus bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul// sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sku lus gang*// zhabs nas brdol te spyi bor zhugs// dam tshig nyams chags sdig sgrib kun// dag nas rang lus 'od phung gyur// oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes ci nus bzla/ spro na/ oṃ karma satwa sa ma ya sogs las rigs kyi yig brgya'ang bzlas la mthar/ bcom ldan dam tshig rdo rje yis// bdag gi dam tshig nyams chags kun// dag cing dam tshig gtsang ba dang*// dam tshig sems dpa' mchog sgrub mdzod// mos gus dag pos gsol btab pas// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang nyid dam tshig rdo rje sems// snang la rang bzhin med par gyur// dge ba 'di yis sogs brjod/ ces pa'ang dge bshes kun dga' rgyal mtshan ngor gu ṇas spel ba dge legs 'phel/// /sarba maṅgalaṃ/// /
